passages.note: true adds the text read from each source page; each source then carries an excerpt, mapped to content.

compact.note: true returns compact sources only, each snippet built from the page's best-matching lines.

speed.note: fast runs the fast tier, at $1 per 1k searches of up to 10 results.

page.note: 1 to 10; continues the same ranked list, num results a page.

images.note: true returns image results in place of web results.

language.note: Two letters, sent to every engine that takes it.

country.note: Two letters, sent to every engine that takes it.

like.note: Up to 20 addresses of pages to find more of.

unlike.note: Up to 20 addresses of pages to keep out.

pages_wait_ms.note: 0 to 3500; how long passages or compact waits for page text.
